cases.name: Two more years, answered rather than interrogated
cases.gap: Measured on 2026-09-13, then re-diagnosed from the report. The failure is not that projection is missing -- it is that no scenario was produced: scenario_set is empty and the calculation carries no variants, so "work two more years" was answered with the base retire-now figure ($32,126.78 on 21.5 years) three turns running. `extract_scenarios` reads "wait 2 more years"; it does not read this phrasing, and nothing else recognised it. Turn 2 ("assume I get a 3% raise") is a second gap: a growth rule is not a fact the worksheet holds, so nothing goes stale and nothing recomputes.
